title: A triage hand-over quotes the merge --reviewed line for its head
why: Triage handed #2379 over at 042143e5c (2026-11-11 07:47 CST) after a fix check, but main's `merge --reviewed` read 'a guard or check change owes the final round and its net value after a fix check'. Same gate as the 04:46 CST withdrawal. Harm: one wasted coordinator check and a late release per miss. Fix: the hand-over message carries the `merge --reviewed` line for the PR, and a send to the coordinator that names a PR with an open line is refused.
